solve.method: Re-read north-east eave (158,638): the old (169,608) mark lay on the gable slope. Fit level shifted camera to grade/eave and plan-based horizontal window-group/street controls, excluding tower and gable apex. Eye height1.8m is reconstructed; focal length solved, not assumed from a nominal lens.
solve.units: W and z in feet, observed u/v pixels; null vertical controls omitted
solve.limitations: Plan windows +/-0.4 ft and hand picks several pixels. Level camera omits slight image lean. Other roof controls are checks, not fitted.
